verdict.rationale: PayPal's developer docs cover REST API auth, checkout button integration, webhooks, sandbox testing, and even codegen for SDKs (paypal-docs-1,2,9,11,16), suggesting a structured path to integrate payments. However, there's no direct evidence of copy-paste code samples in multiple specific languages, nor confirmation that a full working flow can realistically be completed in under a day; community evidence focuses on account holds/disputes rather than dev-experience quality. missing for 10: language-specific copy-paste snippets, explicit time-to-integrate benchmarks, independent developer corroboration of a fast integration experience.
